dialect.detail: IBM CICS online program using EXEC CICS PUT/GET CONTAINER (CICS channels/containers API, CICS TS 3.1+), likely running on z/OS. Uses DFHCOMMAREA linkage pattern.

purpose.domain_detail: Credit card fraud detection using a machine learning model scoring service (ALNSCORE) invoked via CICS channels/containers
purpose.summary: FRAUDMOD is a CICS online program that takes credit card transaction input data (amount, merchant info, card, etc.) from DFHCOMMAREA, packages it into CICS containers on a channel, invokes an ML scoring program (ALNSCORE) via EXEC CICS LINK, retrieves the output prediction/probability, and returns results. It appears to interface with an AI/ML inference engine (ALN prefix suggests IBM z/OS AI scoring).

notable_features: EXEC CICS PUT CONTAINER / GET CONTAINER (CICS channels and containers)
EXEC CICS LINK to ML scoring program ALNSCORE
DFHCOMMAREA with COPY-based input/output model structures
UUID-style MODEL_ID (GUID) for ML model identification
ALN_ prefixed containers suggesting IBM z/OS AI scoring framework
PERFORM UNTIL loop displaying probability array
verdict.notes: The program is short but structurally complete and uses advanced CICS features (channels/containers). The ALN prefix and MODEL_ID UUID strongly suggest IBM Z AI/ML scoring integration (possibly IBM Watson Machine Learning for z/OS or similar). COPY members MODELIN and MODELOUT are not shown. Some commented-out debug/test code remains.
